correctness.rationale: Normalized degree-0/1 real spherical reproducing kernel K(x,y)=1+d<x,y> gives one-pair MSE = (d-1)||f||²/2 + E[f(X)f(Y)(1+d<X,Y>)]/2. Haar symmetrization cannot raise the top error eigenvalue, and yields levels A=d(1+u)/2 and B=(d-1+u+dv)/2 with u=E<T>, v=E<T²>=u²+Var T. The exact factorization A-B(u,u²)=(1-u)(1+du)/2 yields unique minimizer u=-1/d and v=u², hence T=-1/d almost surely even for nonsymmetric originals. Explicit Haar-invariant tangent-circle coupling realizes the equality; independent and antipodal baselines checked. Separate Sympy calculations reran key identities for d=3,4,8; empirical spectrum is only corroboration, not proof.
